prompts.text_preservation: Only physical line separators removed; source spaces preserved
prompts.source_text_status: Published rCM-linked extended text, used verbatim

provenance.recipe: Settings of the run behind the paper's 4-NFE H3 result; see README 'Recipe'.
provenance.train_shift: The student's training rollout uses the UNSHIFTED 4-step grid [1, .75, .5, .25, 0] for video and audio; video_shift/audio_shift (12/3) are the sampling shifts used at inference only.
provenance.buckets: 544p, 20 equally likely entries (height, width): 12x 544x960, 4x 960x544, one each of 640x832, 832x640, 736x736, 480x1120.
provenance.frames: 124 frames at 24 fps (37 video latents, 207 audio latents).
provenance.critic_time: video sigma ~ U(0,1); audio sigma ~ U(0,1), redrawn from U(.85,1) when video sigma > .95.
provenance.score_time: sigma'' ~ U(sigma[k+1], sigma[k]) below the student's step k, one ratio shared by video and audio.
provenance.losses: MSE without the 0.5 factor, weighted 0.8 per modality, each clamped to at most 5; gradient norm clipped at 1.0 per role.
provenance.purpose: full-shape smoke test: 6 updates = 5 critic + 1 student, rolling checkpoint at 3 and 6, LoRA milestone at 6
